entries.claim: The exact pinned 107-word direct reading differs from the selected Latin at seven punctuation loci, the spelling Jam and the substantive inflection petra. No inherited text, macro or concluding response is part of this body.

The Benziger 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page prints the complete 107-word Epistle, beginning in the lower left column and ending in the upper right before Graduale. The announcement and scripture reference are framing; no expansion or concluding response is included.
